newsitem.title: ITALY: Italfondiario H1 1996 gross profit up.
newsitem.headline: Italfondiario H1 1996 gross profit up.

text.p: Italian special credit institution Italfondiario posted a first half 1996 consolidated gross profit of 2.9 billion lire against 1.5 billion in the same 1995 period.
Istituto Italiano di Credito Fondiario said in a statement gross revenues totalled 525.7 billion lire against 491.7 billion. Parent company net profit was 366 million lire versus 337 million lire.
Customer loans totalled 8.63 trillion lire compared with 8.72 trillion while deposits slipped to 7.87 trillion lire from 8.09 trillion.
Bad loans rose to 1.2 trillion lire from 951.4 billion.
